killedBy: finishWith -- ending a session with a given outcome (issue #591) refuses to re-end an ended session, which is what keeps the panel still
why: Drops the `playing` guard, so an already-ended session can be ended again. Issue #591's capture flag fires from `onSimulated`, which runs on EVERY frame, so this turns one ending into an ending rebuilt sixty times a second -- under a player who may already have pressed a button on the panel. The loop clears its own arm after the first success, which is why only a test that calls `finishWith` twice can see this: the two halves guard the same thing from opposite sides, and either alone looks sufficient.
